desc: WhisperTech offers a unique suppressor system utilizing the patented Couvillion method, distinguishing it from traditional Maxim method suppressors. It offers smaller, lighter, and more accurate features with comparable sound attenuation at the muzzle and improved performance at the shooter’s ear position. Key features include minimizing ballistic POI shift, reduced muzzle flip, minimal breach blowback, and user-serviceability. Originating from the need to meet specific requirements, the WhisperTech line offers solutions for multiple use cases.
